solution.what: Telegrams transcribed from the JACAR PDFs; doubtful letters re-read by Brice Dudout in blind panels.
Search of the condenser family (consonant rotation, vowel order) scored with a Chinese character model; key accepted only if it read telegrams it was not fitted to.
Chinese text punctuated and translated; doubtful codes marked.
Read share recounted with sure codes only (README rule of PR #728) from the status column of decryption.txt: 69 of 97 codes (0.711); 4 of 4 telegrams under 95%; class read -> read in part.
Floor for short texts (README, 19 Nov 2026: under 40 codes, at most 2 holes) applied to the 18 Nov counts: no document qualifies; class stays read in part.

validation.notes: Chinese plaintext through the telegraph code: the letter n-gram test cannot run on Chinese characters; the readings were checked by sense

outcome.fraction_read_source: Sure codes only (18 Nov 2026): 69 of 97 codes marked ok (or confirmed) in decryption.txt; doubtful and illegible codes are holes; 4 of 4 telegrams under 95%. Before: probable (doubtful) codes counted as read. Floor for short texts (README, 19 Nov 2026): no document qualifies; 0591 (15/24), 0593 (9/18), 0601a (24/30), 0608a (21/25) stay under the bar, so the class stays read in part.

reading_review.note: 4 telegrams, 28 of 97 codes doubtful; 0601a and 0608a build sense (Shaanxi should wait; send funds), but 0591 and 0593 are mostly doubtful fragments ({鄂}{乳}{廹}; {姣}{宋}{瓀}{襾}{借}{碼}) and the translation of both is largely gaps.
